services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The staff at Camp Gilead would be honored to host your next retreat, camp or conference! Enjoy a quiet, comfortable location for a physically and spiritually refreshing getaway. The facilities are available to churches and Christian ministry groups of 10-180, and we will provide your housing, food service and any other assistance you require to keep your program running smoothly. Rates are custom tailored to your retreat schedule.Example: 3 meals, overnight lodging - $60-65 / personContact the Camp Director jack@campgilead.org for availability and exact pricing of your retreat.
